svg.title: about-me.exe: Saleh Al Saggaf
svg.desc: Saleh Al Saggaf. Senior Software Engineer & Team Lead. Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Senior Software Engineer & Team Lead with 8+ years of experience specializing in front-end development, scalable architectures, and UX-driven applications. Proven ability to lead teams, deliver high-quality products, and align business goals with technical solutions. Strong expertise in Angular, Next.js, and monorepo architectures, with a focus on performance, usability, and system design.
